entries.label: Major depressive disorder
entries.summary: Persistent low mood and/or loss of interest or pleasure for two weeks or more, often with changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, and feelings of worthlessness.
screening_questions: Over the last two weeks, how often have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless?
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

entries.label: Persistent depressive disorder (dysthymia)
entries.summary: Chronically depressed mood lasting most of the day, more days than not, for an extended period (years), with milder but enduring symptoms.
screening_questions: Has this low mood felt like it has been with you most days for a long time, maybe years?

entries.label: Generalized anxiety disorder
entries.summary: Excessive, hard-to-control worry across multiple domains for months, with restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, irritability, muscle tension, or sleep disturbance.
screening_questions: Over the last two weeks, how often have you been unable to stop or control worrying?
Do you find yourself worrying about many different things?

entries.label: Panic disorder
entries.summary: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks — abrupt surges of intense fear with physical symptoms (racing heart, shortness of breath, dizziness) — plus worry about further attacks.
screening_questions: Have you had sudden rushes of intense fear or discomfort that peaked within minutes?
Do you worry about when the next attack might come?

entries.label: Social anxiety disorder
entries.summary: Marked fear or anxiety about social or performance situations where one may be scrutinised, leading to avoidance or intense distress.
screening_questions: Do social situations where you might be judged make you very anxious?
Do you avoid situations because of fear of embarrassment?

entries.label: Post-traumatic stress disorder
entries.summary: Following exposure to a traumatic event: intrusive memories or flashbacks, avoidance of reminders, negative shifts in mood and cognition, and heightened arousal.
screening_questions: Do you have unwanted memories, nightmares, or flashbacks of a difficult event?
Do you avoid reminders, or feel constantly on guard?

entries.label: Adjustment disorder
entries.summary: Emotional or behavioural symptoms out of proportion to an identifiable stressor, arising within three months of the stressor and causing significant distress or impairment.
screening_questions: Did these difficulties begin after a specific stressful change or event?
keywords: struggling to cope with the change

entries.label: Prolonged grief disorder
entries.summary: Persistent, intense grief after bereavement — longing or preoccupation with the deceased — that continues well beyond expected social norms and impairs functioning.
screening_questions: Since the loss, does the grief still feel as intense and consuming as at the start?

entries.label: Obsessive-compulsive disorder
entries.summary: Recurrent intrusive thoughts (obsessions) and/or repetitive behaviours or mental acts (compulsions) performed to reduce distress; time-consuming or impairing.
screening_questions: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming back even when you try to push them away?
Do you feel driven to repeat behaviours like checking, washing, or counting?
keywords: have to do it a certain number

entries.label: Bipolar disorder
entries.summary: Episodes of elevated, expansive, or irritable mood and increased energy (mania/hypomania) that alternate with, or occur alongside, depressive episodes.
screening_questions: Have there been periods where you felt unusually high, wired, or needed little sleep yet had lots of energy?

entries.label: Alcohol use disorder
entries.summary: A problematic pattern of alcohol use causing impairment or distress — loss of control, craving, tolerance, withdrawal, or continued use despite harm.
screening_questions: Have you felt you should cut down on drinking, or found it hard to control?
Has drinking caused problems at home, work, or with health?

entries.label: Substance use disorder
entries.summary: A problematic pattern of psychoactive substance use causing impairment or distress — craving, loss of control, tolerance, withdrawal, or use despite harm.
screening_questions: Have you found it hard to control your use of any substance?
Has use continued despite causing problems?

entries.label: Anorexia nervosa
entries.summary: Restriction of food intake leading to significantly low body weight, intense fear of weight gain, and a disturbance in how body weight or shape is experienced.
screening_questions: Do you restrict eating or feel intense fear of gaining weight?

entries.label: Bulimia nervosa
entries.summary: Recurrent binge eating followed by compensatory behaviours (vomiting, laxatives, fasting, or excessive exercise) to prevent weight gain.
screening_questions: Do you have episodes of eating a lot and feeling out of control, then trying to make up for it?

entries.label: Insomnia disorder
entries.summary: Persistent difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or non-restorative sleep despite adequate opportunity, with daytime distress or impairment.
screening_questions: How has your sleep been — trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking unrefreshed?

entries.label: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder
entries.summary: A persistent pattern of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity, present across settings, that interferes with functioning or development.
screening_questions: Do you struggle with focus, organisation, or restlessness in a way that affects daily life?

entries.label: Borderline personality disorder
entries.summary: A pervasive pattern of instability in relationships, self-image, and emotions, with marked impulsivity, fear of abandonment, and difficulty regulating intense affect.
screening_questions: Do your relationships and sense of self feel intense and unstable, with strong fears of being abandoned?

entries.label: Somatic symptom disorder
entries.summary: One or more distressing physical symptoms accompanied by excessive thoughts, feelings, or behaviours related to those symptoms or to health concerns.
screening_questions: Do worries about physical symptoms or your health take up a lot of your thoughts and time?
keywords: always something wrong with my body
